{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Republican Members of Congress have repeatedly tried to reform the budget process to make it more transparent and accountable.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for a Balanced Budget Amendment to the Constitution, following the lead of 33 States which have put that restraint into their own constitutions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for a Constitutional amendment requiring a super-majority for any tax increase with exceptions for only war and national emergencies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for imposing a cap limiting spending to the historical average percentage of GDP so that future Congresses cannot balance the budget by raising taxes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for the review and examination of all federal agencies to eliminate wasteful spending, operational inefficiencies, or abuse of power.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for returning functions performed by federal agencies to the States, as appropriate, in accordance with the Tenth Amendment of the United States Constitution.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Affirmation that all legislation, rules, and regulations must conform and public servants must adhere to the U.S. Constitution, as originally intended by the Framers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Determination of whether legislation is a State or federal matter must be made in accordance with the Tenth Amendment, in conjunction with Article I, Section 8.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
